"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to slash carbon pollution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to rapidly drive down emissions of potent greenhouse gases like hydrofluorocarbons.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to support developing countries in their efforts to deploy more clean energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to support developing countries in their efforts to invest in climate resilience and adaptation.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to putting the Arctic region at risk through drilling in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to seek collaborative, science-based approaches to be good stewards of the rapidly changing Arctic region while protecting strategic interests.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
